name: Linn County, OR
findings: Linn County has 392 nonprofit organizations. 172 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 139 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Linn County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Linn County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Education organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 12 education organizations here list public events, compared with about 5 in similar places of this size.

observations.text: 28 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
